name: memory
description: Store and retrieve bounded JSON-object records. `create` assigns and returns the record's ref; never invent one or create a duplicate just to obtain a ref. Reuse returned refs with `get`/`update`/`delete`, and list or search first when checking for an existing record. `search` finds records whose values contain all the words of `query`; `delete` removes a record that is no longer true or needed.

operation.description: Create assigns and returns a ref for a new record. Use that exact returned ref for get/update/delete; never invent a ref or create a duplicate just to obtain one. List or search first if checking for an existing record. Delete removes a record for good.

ref.description: For get/update/delete, use the exact ref returned by create, list or search; never invent one. Create assigns and returns its ref.

query.description: For search: words that must all appear, ignoring case, in the record's string or number values; keys are not searched.

filter.description: Top-level or dotted-path exact-match filter for list and search; omitted values inherit from a persistent cursor.

order.description: List and search order; when omitted while continuing, the cursor order is used.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by list or search, given back to the same operation with the same type, query and filter; it continues even if the last record it returned was deleted since.

if_match.description: Optional current ETag for update or delete. On mismatch, the call is rejected and the current_etag is returned; omitted means an unconditional call.
